name: dot11-monitor
description: 802.11 monitor-mode packet work from a host or VM that has already prepared the Wi-Fi interface.

checks.name: docker-daemon
checks.description: Verify that the Docker daemon is available.

checks.name: interface-exists
checks.description: Verify that the selected Wi-Fi monitor-mode interface exists.

checks.name: dot11-monitor-interface
checks.description: Verify that the selected Wi-Fi interface is already in monitor mode.

checks.name: pcap-open
checks.description: Verify that pcap can open the selected monitor-mode interface.

checks.name: dot11-injection-smoke
checks.description: Plan a gated radiotap injection smoke check for the prepared monitor-mode interface.

host_requirements: host or VM preparation owns the Wi-Fi kernel driver, regulatory state, channel, and monitor-mode setup before Docker starts
selected interface must already exist and be in monitor mode on the host or VM
Docker host networking exposes the prepared interface to userland but does not provide Wi-Fi driver or monitor-mode isolation
radiotap injection smoke checks require an explicit live gate and an authorized RF environment

docker_wifi_isolation.reason: Docker supplies userland execution only; host or VM preparation must own Wi-Fi driver state and monitor-mode isolation.
